row.title: ELISION-1, BRIDGE-PROBE-1: an agent PR gutted worker-gate.js and bridged records failed the pins check
row.body: PR 725 replaced seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js with '// ... existing code ...' and carried 50 bridged NC records whose done checks were prose, so the pins check failed and the PR held the agent cap. foundation/executor.py elision_gap refuses an elision marker or a file that loses more than half its lines; scripts/needs_code_bridge.py writes a cmd: done check that asks the deployment whether the item is still parked.
